summary: BizBuzz 2025 grew into a seven-week summer camp, a two-day Fish Tank final at Benedictine University, and workshops at the DuPage and Naperville Children's Business Fairs, reaching 370 students.

programs.title: DuPage Children's Business Fair Workshops
programs.description: Three workshops preparing 30 entrepreneurs for the DuPage Children's Business Fair, guiding them through ideation, marketing, and finance.

programs.title: 2025 Summer Entrepreneurship Camp
programs.description: A free seven-week camp running from June 6 to July 25, covering networking and ideation, the lean canvas, marketing and branding, prototyping, finance, business planning, and pitch rehearsal.

programs.title: Fish Tank 2025
programs.venue: Benedictine University, Goodwin Hall of Business
programs.description: Two-day pitch competition on August 2nd and 3rd where young entrepreneurs presented their ventures to Naperville business owners and leaders.

programs.title: 2025 Naperville Children's Business Fair
programs.description: BizBuzz staff judged a full-day, farmers-market style event at the new Matrix Club, where kidpreneurs ages 5–14 tested the waters of entrepreneurship by selling handmade goods and pitching their small businesses.

timeline.label: DuPage Children's Business Fair Workshops
timeline.detail: Three workshops prepare 30 students for the April 26 fair.

timeline.label: 2025 Summer Camp Begins
timeline.detail: Seven-week entrepreneurship camp opens at the 95th Street Library.

timeline.label: Final Camp Session
timeline.detail: Pitch rehearsal and preparation ahead of Fish Tank.

timeline.label: Fish Tank 2025
timeline.detail: Two-day competition at Benedictine University with 70 competitors.

timeline.label: Naperville Children's Business Fair
timeline.detail: BizBuzz staff judge the full-day fair at the Matrix Club.
